newsitem.title: EGYPT: Cable company paying 9.15 pound div.
newsitem.headline: Cable company paying 9.15 pound div.

text.p: Egyptian Electro Cables will pay an annual dividend of 9.15 pounds for 1995/6, against 8.40 pounds in 1994/5, brokers said on Sunday.
The dividend applies to only three million of the 3.3 million shares in the company. The other 300,000 shares were distributed in October in a one-for-10 free-share issue.
The company raised net distributable profits in 1995/6 to 36.58 million pounds from 36.50 million in the previous year. The years end on June 30.
Shares in the partially privatised company last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange at 111.00 pounds on Wednesday.
